name: Chieda Kizuna
source:
Name: Kizuna Chieda
Sex: Female
Age: 18
Birthday: June 15
Profession: Sekiba High Senior
Likes: Dancing, Shoes, Cinderella, Children, Big Sis
Dislikes: The Unemployed
Hobbies: Dancing, Reading Fairy Tales
Skills: Dancing (All), Reading Fairy Tales

[Past]
The daughter of the uber-rich Chieda family. She is in the dance club at school with Iris and Amame. She is the most gifted singer and dancer in the club; she's even won a contest before. She calls Mizuki "Big Sis."

[From the in-game character description]
